# fizaki

> fizaki is an AI-powered marketing and automation agency for local service
> businesses in India. We build AI missed-call receptionists, WhatsApp booking
> automation, lead qualification and local ad systems for clinics, dental
> practices, gyms, interior designers, solar installers, real estate brokers
> and chartered accountants.

## Core pages
- https://fizaki.com/ : what fizaki does and who it is for
- https://fizaki.com/industries : the six verticals we build for
